settings.reference_methods: scipy solve_ivp RK45 (step sequence) and DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14 (solution)

header.notes: Units: dimensionless. rk45.t is the accepted step sequence of scipy RK45 with automatic first step (t[0] = 0); nfev is SciPy's count including the initial f and the starting-step probe. Arenstorf constants from Hairer, Norsett, Wanner, Solving ODEs I, 2nd ed., Sec. II.0.
